LogText.DefaultText: Guard Nella Thorne thrusts her spear at you!

AlternateLogTexts.DefaultText: Thorne jabs at you with the spear!
Thorne swings the spear at your head!

LogText.DefaultText: You fail to get clear and the spear connects...
You get out of the way in time...
Fortunately, the attack wasn't enough to hurt you.
The spear grazed you, leaving a shallow cut.
The spear nicked your flesh.
You suffered a small puncture wound.
The spear drove into you, drawing blood.
The spear struck true and tore into your flesh.
You suffered a painful spear wound.
The spear pierced you with brutal force.
The spear sinks deep, leaving a terrible wound.
Thorne presses forward with the spear, breathing hard!

AlternateLogTexts.DefaultText: Thorne makes a tired swing with the spear.
Thorne lunges clumsily with the spear.

The spear pierced you with brutal force.
Thorne comes at you fast...
Thorne drops where she stood and does not get back up. You have killed a guard of the village Watch.
Thorne finally gives ground, swearing at you the whole way back across the bridge. She is beaten, but she is not dead.
You break away from Thorne and run.
You have nothing left. Thorne pins you down and shouts for the Captain.

EventDescription.DefaultText: She is already watching you, and she has never once backed off a thing she started. Striking her is a crime whether you win or not.
